    Preview builds may be unstable

    These APKs are generated automatically from ${BRANCH_NAME} on every push. Expect unfinished features, regressions and the occasional crash.

    Preview builds use a separate package name (xyz.mpv.rex.preview), so they install alongside the stable app instead of replacing it. Both can stay installed at the same time.

    How to install

    1. Download the APK that matches your device.
    2. Allow installs from your browser when Android asks.
    3. Open the file and confirm — you're done.
